verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs claim unlimited code completion and next edit suggestions, with completion inside the editor across VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains and Neovim. Hands-on community reports from developers using it daily corroborate that inline completions work as they type. missing for 10: no in-depth first-party documentation or independent corroboration specifically of next-edit-suggestion behavior (the community evidence covers inline completions only).
